chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may God be pleased with him) narrated that Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Yaqub ibn Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Ubaydullah ibn Ali al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Whoever has sexual intercourse with his wife before she reaches nine years old and she sustains an injury, he is liable (for it).
ai.seo_question: What is the legal liability of a husband if his wife is injured during intercourse before she turns nine?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Al-Khisal* establishes the principle of *daman* (financial liability) for a husband who consummates marriage with a wife under the age of nine, attributing any resulting physical defect to his action due to her lack of full physical maturity. It reflects the Shia juristic view that pre-pubertal girls are not fully capable of withstanding marital relations without risk of harm, thereby making the husband strictly liable for any resulting 'ayb' (defect or injury). This ruling underscores the importance of physical readiness (*bulugh*) in ensuring the well-being of the spouse within the marital contract.
